title: Diffusion models with physics-guided inference for solving partial differential equations
summary: Diffusion models have recently emerged as powerful stochastic frameworks for high-dimensional inference and generation. However, existing applications to partial differential equations (PDEs) predominantly rely on physics-informed training strategies, which tightly couple learning with specific governing equations and limit generalization across problem settings.
